2608.14426.title: The Dynamics of Intelligence Explosions
2608.14426.paper_summary: AI is increasingly being used to help with AI R&D. Under certain conditions this feedback loop might be able to produce an intelligence explosion, with rapidly escalating AI capabilities. I explore the mathematics of the most explosive possibilities, with an eye to understanding what drives the dynamics. I show that singular growth (towards a vertical asymptote) is harder to achieve than would be expected from recent economics-inspired modelling, and that there is an important but neglected class of growth rates that are faster than exponential but don't lead to a vertical asymptote. I draw out the generation time (the time to go around the feedback loop) as a neglected parameter that plays a pivotal role in determining the behaviour of any intelligence explosion --- one cannot have singular growth unless the generation time rapidly approaches zero.
2608.14426.paper_summary_zh: AI 正在被越來越多地用於幫助 AI 研發。<lb/>在某些條件下，這種反饋循環可能會產生智力爆炸，導致 AI 能力迅速升級。<lb/>我探討了最具爆炸性可能性的數學，旨在理解驅動這些動態的因素。<lb/>我表明，單一增長（朝向垂直漸近線）比近期經濟學啟發的建模所預期的更難實現，並且存在一類重要但被忽視的增長率，這些增長率比指數增長更快，但不會導致垂直漸近線。<lb/>我指出生成時間（完成反饋循環所需的時間）是一個被忽視的參數，在決定任何智力爆炸的行為中扮演著關鍵角色——除非生成時間迅速接近零，否則無法實現單一增長。
